title: Lamb patties with roast aubergine and minted yoghurt

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Lamb mince, aubergines, onions, tomatoes, Greek yoghurt, spices and crusty bread are all plain home ingredients with nothing factory-made.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any mainstream UK supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a roasting tray, a bowl and a grater, and shaping patties is well within a beginner's reach.

works.reason: Aubergine gets about 33 minutes at 220°C and small patties get 15 to 18 minutes, so both cook through, and 500g lamb with two aubergines and bread feeds four; salting the patties is a gap any cook would fill.

honest_times.reason: Cubing, wedging, grating and chopping fit in 15 minutes, the patties can be shaped while the veg roasts, and 15 plus 18 minutes matches the 33 printed.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the cumin, mint and lemon, is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: Roast aubergine with cherry tomatoes and mint suits early August, and the aubergine is a main part of the tray, not a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English a neighbour could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Lamb, roast vegetables, yoghurt and bread make a proper family dinner.
